title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the values of compassion and contentment
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, said that compassion brings self-respect and contentment brings true happiness. He noted that this spirit further strengthens the bonds of cooperation and harmony in society. The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam- “कारुण्येनात्मनो मानं तृष्णां च परितोषतः। उत्थानेन जयेत्तन्द्रीं वितर्कं निश्चयाज्जयेत्॥” The Subhashitam conveys that self-respect is achieved by showing kindness or compassion to others. Greed is overcome by being satisfied at one's fortune in life. One must conquer laziness, dubious reasoning and indecisiveness by exertion and entrepreneurship. The Prime Minister wrote on X; “करुणा से आत्म-सम्मान और संतोष से सच्ची खुशी मिलती है। इसी भाव से समाज में सहयोग और सद्भाव की डोर और सशक्त होती है। कारुण्येनात्मनो मानं तृष्णां च परितोषतः। उत्थानेन जयेत्तन्द्रीं वितर्कं निश्चयाज्जयेत्॥”
करुणा से आत्म-सम्मान और संतोष से सच्ची खुशी मिलती है। इसी भाव से समाज में सहयोग और सद्भाव की डोर और सशक्त होती है। कारुण्येनात्मनो मानं तृष्णां च परितोषतः। उत्थानेन जयेत्तन्द्रीं वितर्कं निश्चयाज्जयेत्॥ pic.twitter.com/w22hrkGaH2 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 24, 2026

enrichment.summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media platform X, highlighting that compassion brings self-respect while contentment brings true happiness. He noted that this spirit strengthens cooperation and harmony in society, and that laziness and indecisiveness should be overcome through effort and entrepreneurship.
enrichment.context: This is a routine social media post by the Prime Minister sharing an inspirational Sanskrit verse (Subhashitam), a genre of pithy moral or philosophical couplets from classical Sanskrit literature. Such posts are a recurring feature of the PM's public communication, often shared to convey values like compassion, contentment, and diligence, without any accompanying policy announcement or governmental decision.
